basic_info.description: Exceptional and elegantly updated three-bedroom, one bath Mid-century home with enchanting panoramic views and on the border of two electrifying neighborhoods: Excelsior and Portola. This cheerful home opens to an inviting entryway leading to the living area with eastern views, a tastefully remodeled eat-in kitchen with brand new cabinets and appliances, gleaming wood floors, an updated bathroom with designer finishes, and two bedrooms all on the same level awash with natural light and graced with glorious views. There is an additional room on the lower level along with a spacious garage with plenty of room for storage, a laundry area and possible potential for expansion. The low maintenance outdoor space presents a blank canvas for the new owner to create their own outdoor oasis for entertaining, gardening, or restful repose Don't miss this home that is close to shopping, restaurants, cafes, playgrounds, parks, public transportation, HWY 101/280 and more!
